ModMetaData.name: VFE Ancients (HSK/CE Patched)
ModMetaData.author: Oskar Potocki, xrushha, legodude17 — HSK/CE patch by CarbineAction
ModMetaData.description:
HSK/CE-patched version of Vanilla Factions Expanded - Ancients, tuned for the Hardcore SK modpack.
Original mod by Oskar Potocki, xrushha, legodude17. This patch version rebalances ingredients to HSK's refined-metal economy, gates Ancient Soldier raids to late-game wealth thresholds, and bundles the community-made CE compatibility patches.
--- HSK-NATIVE TUNING ---
INGREDIENTS — All raw <Steel> ingredient references (used as material costs in vault buildings, sentry guns, and ancient-tech recipes) have been swapped to <SteelBar> (HSK refined metal) with 1:5 scaling, since HSK's "Steel" is raw iron ore and SteelBar is the refined product. Plasteel, ComponentIndustrial, and ComponentSpacer references are preserved (HSK uses these names natively).
RAID GATING — VFEA_AncientSoldiers faction has a raidCommonalityFromPointsCurve added that gates raid eligibility to 1500+ raid points (~80k wealth, mid-late game). Without this, ancient soldiers could be picked by the storyteller for early-game tribal raids despite being spacer-tier supersoldiers. Vault-spawned ancients (when the player breaks into a sealed vault) are unaffected — those use a separate spawn mechanism, not the raid system, so the player can still encounter them on demand.
--- PRESERVED ---
Full VFE Ancients gameplay: - Hidden + Sealed + Looted vault scattering on the world map - Ancient burst-signal interception quest line - Super-soldier nanite injection workshop with ability tree - Vault scenarios (start as a vault guard) - Custom faction soldiers, sentry guns, abilities, and lore content
--- BUNDLED CE PATCHES ---
Community-made HSK CE patches (originally at G:\HSK CE patches\Vanilla Factions Expanded - Ancients\) bundled and gated by IfModActive="CETeam.CombatExtended" in LoadFolders.xml. Covers: - Symbol defs (custom gen) - CustomGenDefs vault layouts - Hediff-driven super-soldier ability stat patches - Ability damage / verb patches - Ancient soldier PawnKindDefs (CE armor/weapon/ammo loadouts) - Sentry gun ThingDef (CE turret stats + ammo)
--- COMPATIBILITY ---
Requires: HSK (skyarkhangel.hsk), Combat Extended (CETeam.CombatExtended), Harmony, VE Framework, Ideology DLC. NOT compatible with original "VanillaExpanded.VFEA" — enable this INSTEAD.
